title: int arithmetic is exact beyond signed 64-bit
purpose: int is an exact integer: results beyond signed 64-bit do not wrap (R01).
spec_refs: Go spec: Integer overflow; Integer operators

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: language owner decision R01 (OIR-1 §23, 20.10.2026), superseding D-016 of 19.10.2026: int is an exact bigint, so +, -, * and unary minus never wrap; MIN % -1 is 0.

notes: D-016 (wrap as in Go) was superseded by R01; the case id is kept for history.
